title: Unsupervised Surrogate-Assisted Synthesis of Free-Form Planar Antenna Topologies for IoT Applications
summary: Design of antenna structures for Internet of Things (IoT) applications is a challenging problem. Contemporary radiators are often subject to a number of electric and/or radiation-related requirements, but also constraints imposed by specifics of IoT systems and/or intended operational environments. Conventional approaches to antenna design typically involve manual development of topology intertwined with its tuning. Although proved useful, the approach is prone to errors and engineering bias.
